definitions.applyMethod: NEXUS applies the live Hyprland value, saves the Lua source, and verifies a live readback.

definitions.applyMethod: Not available until both general.lua writers use a shared transactional lock, validate the combined file, and provide verified rollback.
definitions.description: This helper edits the AEGIS acrylic section in Hyprland custom/general.lua and reloads Hyprland. The window-effects helper also writes this file, and the two writers have no shared lock. NEXUS keeps this unavailable until both helpers use coordinated validation and rollback.
definitions.title: Acrylic blur

definitions.applyMethod: Existing helper; reloads Hyprland after confirmation.
definitions.description: Per-window opacity exceptions from the existing Advanced control. Profiles, reset, and undo use the same helper and ask before reloading Hyprland.
definitions.title: Custom window rules

definitions.applyMethod: Not available until NEXUS coordinates game detection, live option snapshots, service shutdown, profile loading, and reset without competing writes.
definitions.description: The existing Pulsar service automatically changes live Hyprland options when a game is detected and restores a runtime snapshot when the service exits. The existing automatic game-mode toggle (`gameMode.automatic`) is already supported separately. NEXUS keeps this script integration unavailable until its runtime lifecycle is coordinated with profiles and reset.
definitions.title: Pulsar Game Mode

definitions.applyMethod: The existing helper applies allowlisted profiles and reloads Hyprland after confirmation; it checks configuration errors.
definitions.description: Existing script-backed control. Its effective value, initial state, and rollback procedure need an adapter review.
definitions.title: Motion profile

definitions.applyMethod: Not available until all rules.lua writers use a shared transactional lock, validate the combined file, and provide verified rollback.
definitions.description: This helper edits opacity options in Hyprland custom/rules.lua and reloads Hyprland. Picture-in-picture and custom-opacity helpers also write this file, with no shared writer lock. NEXUS keeps this unavailable until the writers are coordinated and rollback is verified.
definitions.title: Opaque window exceptions

definitions.applyMethod: Not available until all rules.lua writers use a shared transactional lock, validate the combined file, and provide verified rollback.
definitions.description: This helper edits the picture-in-picture section in Hyprland custom/rules.lua and reloads Hyprland. Opacity-rules and custom-opacity helpers also write this file, with no shared writer lock. NEXUS keeps this unavailable until the writers are coordinated and rollback is verified.
definitions.title: Picture in picture

definitions.applyMethod: Not available until both general.lua writers use a shared transactional lock, validate the combined file, and provide verified rollback.
definitions.description: This helper edits window opacity and depth in Hyprland custom/general.lua and reloads Hyprland. The integration.acrylic-blur helper also writes this file, and the two writers have no shared lock. NEXUS keeps this unavailable until both helpers use coordinated validation and rollback.
definitions.title: Window opacity and depth

definitions.applyMethod: Existing glow helper validates and writes the saved glow state and generated Hyprland config; profile/reset/undo actions ask before reloading Hyprland.
definitions.description: The existing Advanced window glow control is captured by NEXUS profiles and can be reset or undone through the same validated helper.
definitions.title: Window glow
